questions.question: Whom did Samuel anoint as the next king, in Bethlehem?
options: Jonathan, the eldest son of King Saul
David, the youngest son of Jesse
questions.answer: David, the youngest son of Jesse

questions.question: What does God look at, rather than outward appearance?
David was the youngest of Jesse's sons and was keeping the sheep.
The LORD said man looks at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the _____.
Samuel anointed _____, the youngest son of Jesse, as the next king.
